[[Riverside Province]] is the southernmost Krytan province, an area with major Krytan settlements surrounded by marshland. The White Mantle have a heavy presence due to their major base, the [[Temple of the Unseen]] being located here.

==Getting there==
Talk to [[Blade Operative Paulina]] in [[Sanctum Cay (outpost)|Sanctum Cay]].

==Shrines==
There are no shrines. Instead, parties will be resurrected at the starting point.

==NPCs==
